name: ITE Data Pipelines Workshop
postCreateCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && sudo mkdir -p /opt/airflow-venv && sudo chown $(id -u):$(id -g) /opt/airflow-venv && python -m venv /opt/airflow-venv &&/opt/airflow-venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && /opt/airflow-venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-airflow.txt --constraint https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/airflow/constraints-3.3.2/constraints-3.12.txt && make init
